headline: Google drops Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video price 30% and adds 15-second video
body: Google says Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash introduces native 15-second video creation and multi-turn conversational editing. It dropped the price 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1, to $0.07 per second for 720p video, and it is now generally available.
note: For banks and payment firms, the lower per-second price makes AI video cheaper to try in marketing or customer material.

evidence.text: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash introduces native 15-second video creation, multi-turn conversational editing capabilities, and enhanced reference following.
We have dropped the price 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 making it available at $0.07 per second for 720p video.
And for the first time, Gemini Omni is now generally available, backed by Google Cloud’s enterprise-grade infrastructure and security.
